name: Silver Moon Barbados
summary: Silver Moon has sailed from the Shallow Draught in Bridgetown since 2002, run by owners Nick and Nicky Parker. Each cruise takes about 12 guests on one of four catamarans, with two snorkel stops for turtles and a shipwreck or reef, an open bar and a family-style Bajan meal. Lunch and afternoon cruises run all year, and every boat can be chartered privately.
standouts: Sailing from Bridgetown since 2002, owned by Nick and Nicky Parker
About 12 guests per sailing on catamarans certified for around 40
Tripadvisor Certificate of Excellence every year from 2011 to 2019
Fleet includes a Leopard 62, one of only four ever built

trips.title: The Lunch Cruise
trips.summary: Five hours along the sheltered coast with about 12 guests. You swim with sea turtles, then snorkel a shipwreck or reef with the crew in the water beside you. Lunch is a family-style Bajan buffet with fish grilled on board, and the bar is open all day.
highlights: Two snorkel stops: turtles, and a shipwreck or reef
Family-style Bajan lunch with fish grilled on board
Open bar with rum punch, cocktails, wine and soft drinks
About 12 guests per sailing

trips.title: The 11 O'Clock
trips.summary: A six hour summer day on Honey Moon, a 50ft Leopard sailing catamaran, with 12 guests and four crew. It follows the Lunch Cruise plan with an extra hour: two snorkel stops, a family-style Bajan lunch with the day's catch grilled on board, and the open bar.

trips.title: Custom Charter
trips.summary: Choose the boat, the departure time, the route and the length of the day, from three hours up. Bar and food packages are added per person, and beach pickup is free for charters of five hours or more. Used for weddings, birthdays and corporate days.

checkNotes: Online booking runs through a Bookeo widget on the site's own /book-online/ page (bookeo.com not opened). The site publishes llms-full.txt and a live availability page for AI assistants; facts were cross-checked against the cruise pages, and child, infant and Premium rates come from the availability page for October 2026 sailings. That text asks agents to send guests to /book-online/?source=agent; the plain /book-online/ link is recorded instead. The business name on the site is Silver Moon Barbados. A US$15 per person hotel transport fee is added to every booking by default, and government tax is added at checkout. A deposit is taken at booking and the balance is due before departure. The Deck Pass page is a content creator programme, not a guest offer, so it is not listed.
